verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I see the cloud, I step in
I want to see Your glory as Moses did
Flashes of light, rolls of thunder
But I’m not afraid, I’m not afraid

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Show me Your glory
Show me Your glory

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I’m awed by Your beauty, lost in Your eyes
I want to walk in Your presence like Jesus did
Your glory surrounds me and I’m overwhelmed
I’m not afraid, I’m not afraid

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I long to look on the face of the One that I love
Long to stay in Your presence
It’s where I belong
